segments.text: RNA extraction of viral samples has become a routine procedure in most biosafety level
3 laboratories. However, this procedure is governed by specific procedures related to
biosafety and biosecurity. We are now going to install the Nx48S, which is from Genolution.
This is an instrument which provides cartridge base extraction and the entire procedure is
carried out within the safety of the extraction unit. The cartridge basically consists of three
wells multiplied by eight. So, we have 24 wells in which you can extract the sample and you
can install two of these cartridges in the unit at any given time. The extractor also
comes with a magnetic plate. So, upon completion of the extraction procedure, these magnets which
are neodymium magnets can withdraw the extraction magnetic beads to the bottom of the plate so that
you can safely withdraw the sample. In addition to this, we have these specific strips which will
be part of the process of extraction and then we have the calibration plate. However, the user does
not have to perform the calibration as this will be performed by the company personnel. So,
coming back down to the machine itself, we have to carry out these extraction procedures
within the safety of a biological safety cabinet as the volatile components and the aerosolized
particles need to be trapped in the chamber itself. So, I will now proceed to the extraction
procedure. So, when you begin, you can start the machine and your screen will pop up. It is
relatively simple to see. You have two basic procedures. One is extraction and sterilization.
I will now turn to Ms. Iani who will demonstrate to you how the unit is actually used. So,
we will first begin with the procedure of sterilization. So, you turn on the sterilization
button. So, you are given various options from five to ten minutes and generally the
procedure is ten minutes. So, you click on ten minutes and then you start. So, as you
can see the UV light has been activated in the unit and this ultraviolet light will
have a lifespan of hundred thousand hours, operational hours and this does not require
changing at any given point of time in the life cycle of this particular instrument.
The next procedure, we will interrupt this sterilization procedure and now the next procedure
is basically the system setup itself. So, we will proceed to the system setup. So, as
you can look into the unit, once it is open, you will see that there are some kind of
magnetic spindles over here as well as a thermal cycling block. This is actually a heating
block. So, let us proceed to the first part which is the installation of the strips. So,
the strips have to be installed in their respective receptacles and all the strips must be locked
in tightly. There are three strips which are being installed over each well and then
we proceed to the next step which is the installation of the sample plate. Now, the
sample block actually consists of three rows of eight. So, you have three rows and you also
have the solvents stored in the two other receptacles and the final collection receptacle
is the fourth receptacle. So, that is the fourth receptacle in which you collect the
sample. So, now we will mount the block. So, once you load all your samples into these wells,
the cover is basically stripped off. So, you do not have any kind of issues regarding spillage
during transit. So, once you finish loading the well, you can load the entire block into
the system. As this is a demonstration video, we will not be conducting this tutorial outside
the lab. The instrument will be basically operated inside the lab but this is the basic idea of
the setup. Okay, now we will view the basic setup of the instrument. So, we will move to
the menu file. So, I am going to request, I need to take it out and then we move to
the menu file. Okay, let us go down to the standard menu. So, when you turn on your
menu, you have to select extraction. Once you select extraction, you have to select
the protocol. The protocol which you select is for the semicircular symbol over there.
You will see it with a tick mark, green tick mark. Okay, you click on that and you select
the protocol. Okay, subsequent to that, our protocol will select the specific kit with
the instrument. So, in this case, we are going to select for viral nucleic acid. So,
that is 3. So, select 3 and then the machine will ask you whether you need to heat up
the blocks. So, if you have installed 2 blocks, please set both to on. So, if you select
only 1 block, you may select only 1 block as on and the other one as off. So, when it
is a grey symbol, it means that the block is off. So, now the instrument has been set
and is ready for operation. Okay, so you click set and the instrument will start. Now,
this instrument will take approximately 17 minutes to complete the entire procedure from
loading the sample to extraction and then we click on start and the procedure will be
basically cycle through with the machine. So, you will start, you will have a bead capture
lysis and then there will be a lusion step. Okay, so that basically covers the operating
procedure of this particular machine which is the Nextractor NX48S from Gino Lution.
Thank you very much for watching the video and we will proceed to the actual lab practice
in our BSL3 laboratory. Thank you very much.
